title: simpright init answers
description: What simpright init sets up in a fresh copy of SimpRightTemplate (simpright init --answers <file>). /simpright-setup writes these from its interview. Every key is optional: a missing one keeps the template's choice, so an empty file (or --defaults) changes nothing.

layers.description: The layers the project tests. A layer left out loses its examples and its keys in simpright.yml (ids.layers, paths.<layer>Tests, agents.<layer>; for ui also parts.inspector and commands.inspectUi). The core keeps its files for both.

app.description: The app under test: its URLs (src/envs/TEST.json) and the attribute it marks elements with for tests (src/config/project.ts).

baseUrl.description: The app's URL. An API-only project without one gets apiBaseUrl.

apiBaseUrl.description: The API's URL. A UI-only project without one gets baseUrl.

login.description: How a user logs in (src/config/project.ts). none: no login yet, so tests run logged out. bearer: an API login that returns a bearer token (and writes src/api/clients/AuthClient.ts). Any other login stays none here, and /simpright-setup writes it with you.

path.description: The login endpoint, relative to apiBaseUrl, e.g. /auth/login.

body.description: The request body's fields and the user value each one takes, e.g. { email: username, password: password }.

tokenField.description: The response body's field with the token, e.g. access_token.

expiresInSeconds.description: How long a token lives, when the response doesn't say.

expiresInField.description: The response body's field with the token's lifetime in seconds, e.g. expires_in.

localStorageKey.description: Where a logged-in page keeps the token (localStorage), so UI tests can start logged in. Without it, project.browserState stays a stub that says what to write.

roles.description: The roles tests act as, the first being the default (src/config/roles.ts; simpright.yml roles, with guest for logged-out tests). Each names its user's .env variables, written into src/envs/TEST.json (testUsers) and .env.example; {} for a role whose user is created per run.

examples.description: keep: the examples stay (those of the layers kept). remove: they go, and with the agents part they move to docs/exemplars/ as the agents' style exemplars.

folders.description: Folders outside the core, relative to the project's root: an existing one moves, a new one is created. src/ and tests/ keep the template's layout.

config.description: simpright.yml's own keys, each a complete value in its schema (ci with node and secrets, portal with a title), merged into the file: a mapping key by key, so the comments of what it keeps stay; a list or a value replaced.

variable.description: An environment variable's name, e.g. ADMIN_PASSWORD.
